title: 命不是固定轨迹：结构约束下的轨迹分叉
concept_statement: 不要把同一命盘理解为一条预写好的固定人生剧本。项目可以研究一种解释框架：先天结构对可能的反应空间施加约束，而现实轨迹还与时间环境、已形成状态、主体行动和外部条件有关。
formalization: S_(t+1) = F(S_t, N, E_t, A_t, C_t; θ). This is a research/product modeling hypothesis, not a source-given dynamical law.
motivation: The flat chart-to-event mapping risks collapsing environment, state, action and context and makes post-hoc explanations too easy. A trajectory representation keeps these factors conceptually distinct and leaves room for empirical failure.
implications: Keep N, E_t, S_t, A_t and C_t as separate modeling objects.
Do not turn a temporal configuration into a guaranteed event.
Do not treat user choice as the same thing as external disturbance.
Require held-out evaluation before claiming predictive increment.
boundaries: This is a project research philosophy, not a canonical Zhongzhou doctrine or a quote from Wang Tingzhi.
The cited project artifacts do not provide empirical validation of the trajectory equation.
APPROVED_RATIONALE means preserved as project rationale, not a formal source-truth promotion.
